ideas.pitch: An AI-powered mobile web tool that allows citizens to snap photos of street garbage or overflowing municipal bins, automatically classifying the waste type, severity, and exact GPS coordinates for routing to local sanitation squads.
ideas.title: CleanStreet AI - Geo-tagged Garbage & Overflow Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles street action and waste collection tracks with a GPS-driven community workflow, mirroring successful civic tech pattern of live municipal dashboards.

ideas.pitch: A simulated IoT edge-monitoring dashboard using ultrasonic distance sensors and camera feeds to predict urban water-logging and garbage choke-points in drainage systems before monsoons.
ideas.title: DrainSight - IoT & Vision-Based Drain Blockage Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on drain monitoring, a highly specific and critical problem in Indian cities during monsoons, combining hardware simulation with predictive analytics.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision pipeline that runs on a Raspberry Pi or webcam simulation to instantly classify dry, wet, hazardous, and electronic waste, guiding informal waste pickers with voice prompts in regional Indian languages.
ideas.title: BinBot Vision - Edge AI Waste Segregator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets hardware & IoT and waste collection & segregation tracks with practical edge AI that can be demonstrated live via webcam.

ideas.pitch: An AI-matching platform connecting local ragpickers and small kabadiwalas (scrap dealers) with industrial recycling units, streamlining scrap pickup schedules and fair-pricing transparency.
ideas.title: EcoKabaad - Circular Economy B2B Scrap Matchmaker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the recycling & circular economy track by creating clear economic incentives and quantifiable waste diversion metrics for informal workers.

ideas.pitch: An interactive WhatsApp or web-based AI assistant that teaches children and housing societies proper waste segregation rules through region-specific quizzes, image-based audit challenges, and point systems.
ideas.title: KachraKosh - Multilingual Gamified Civic Education Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the civic education track by leveraging LLMs to deliver hyper-local, multilingual guidance tailored to Indian municipal waste norms.
